title: Voxel Grid Downsample
hints: Voxel index = floor(p / leaf) per axis. Use std::floor, not an int cast: the cast truncates toward zero, so −0.01 and 0.01 would share a voxel.
Key = three int64 values. std::unordered_map needs a hash functor: e.g. (x·73856093) ^ (y·19349663) ^ (z·83492791), plus operator== on the key.
Accumulate (sum, count) per voxel in a single pass, then emit sum / count. Call reserve() on the map and the output.
Alternative (deterministic, cache friendly): compute keys, sort indices by key, then average runs of equal keys.
